reviews.title: Another one bites the dust
reviews.text:
As many others have stated, I purchased the lifetime plan, only to find a switch to a subscription model at 30 dollars a year, with AI credits needed for many of the features. This cash grab is unfortunate. I get the world is moving this way, but there are more full features apps that can do what this app does for less (or at least more options). Plus note the phone can natively do many of the things the free legacy version does. 

Thanks for a few years of use (not a lifetime). 

Enjoy the cash grab while it lasts, if it does. But I can’t support an app that costs what you want, plus charges free to utilize the AI features. Especially when it makes it unclear which features I can’t save my photos when using.

reviews.title: Am I crazy?
reviews.text: Please believe me when I say that I did not want to leave a negative review.  I have had this app for years.  I’m pretty sure I got it by chance when it first dropped.  It used to be so reliable.  Idk why, but now it is borderline unusable.  The majority of the time, when I go to edit a photo, as soon as it gets to the editing screen, it freezes and then crashes.  I would say that it works to some extent about 1/10 of the time, but still slow, lagging, and rough.  Overall, for the past year, it has been slow, buggy, and unreliable.  Originally, this app was wayyyy ahead of the game for tech like this.  But now I feel like it’s just… bad and disappointing.  I always keep up with software updates.  I always read new policies, instructions, and provided info. I am devastated.  I don’t want to learn how to use a new app, but I think I will have to.  If you are looking to get this app, I recommend trying a different one first.  These days, competitors offer essentially the same service.  I feel like this app genuinely, on occasion, is good and maybe some people have very good experiences.  Just not worth the risk and effort. Dang…

reviews.title: Your Greed Sickens Me
reviews.text: This app used to be free, entirely and completely free. It’s a great retouching app, it works well for its intended use. I have been using it for a few years now with no issues. The other day I went on it after a couple months of not using it, and now you are only allowed to save one photo per day. Yes, that’s right, ONE save allowed per day. If you want to edit multiple photos and save all of them in one session, well guess what, you have to PAY! Unbelievable. They have a screenshot block in place too, of course, lest you try saving your work without lining their pockets first! Nothing enrages me more than a feature that used to be free being locked behind a paywall with no warning or explanation. I will not give you a penny of my money only for the principle of it. What you’re doing is shady and greedy. You had a great app here and you ruined it. Congratulations.

reviews.title: Misleading “One-Time Purchase” (Features Now Locked Behind Subscription)
reviews.text: I purchased this app back when it was explicitly sold as a one-time purchase, before any subscription model existed. The promise at the time was clear: permanent access to the features available then. Now, despite that, the app blocks basic functionality like saving edited photos unless I pay for a monthly subscription. This directly contradicts their own messaging that earlier buyers would retain access to the features they already paid for. Repackaging core functionality behind a subscription and effectively holding users’ existing purchases hostage is misleading and unacceptable. This feels like a retroactive change to the deal, and it seriously undermines trust. If you value transparency and respect for early customers, be cautious.
